PDN interoperability fixtures
============================
Untitled2.pdn, oldPDN3510.pdn and FlattenBlendTest.pdn:
Source: https://github.com/addisonElliott/pypdn/tree/3481b08b3579daf8ab50ecbd03f14619b9c76c8c/tests/data
Author: Addison Elliott. License: MIT; see PYpdn-LICENSE.txt.
Files are unmodified upstream interoperability inputs.
Native5112Resaved.pdn is a Windows application re-save of Untitled2.pdn,
created on 2026-10-24. The original fixture's license applies.
These binary inputs test the PDN interchange format; they are not application artwork.

RustNativeResaved.pdn: Untitled2.pdn decoded/encoded by this Rust codec, then
opened and re-saved by the Windows GUI on 2026-10-25. Same upstream MIT license.

RustAllBlendsResaved.pdn: FlattenBlendTest.pdn decoded/encoded by this Rust codec,
then opened and re-saved by the Windows GUI on 2026-10-25. Same upstream MIT license.

MergeInput.pdn: original six-pixel synthetic input generated by
examples/pdn_merge_probe.rs. Project license: MIT OR Apache-2.0.
MergeNativeOutput.pdn: the same input after merging the upper layer into the lower
one and saving through the Windows GUI on 2026-10-25. Retains hidden-layer state,
opacity, blend mode and string metadata. The original input's project license applies.

MergeAllModesInput.pdn: original 28-layer synthetic input generated by the same
example with --all-modes. MergeAllModesNativeOutput.pdn: each adjacent pair merged
in the Windows GUI, proceeding from top to bottom, then saved on 2026-10-25.
These cover all fourteen blend modes with partial alpha and opacity. Both files
are covered by the project license, MIT OR Apache-2.0.

MetadataInput.pdn: original 17x13 five-layer fixture generated by
examples/pdn_metadata_probe.rs. Includes Unicode layer names and string metadata,
background flags, visibility, alpha edges, hidden RGB, opacity edges and blend modes.
MetadataNativeResaved.pdn: opened and saved by the native Windows application
version 5.1.12 on 2026-10-25; every layer pixel and property survived unchanged.
Both files use the project license, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
MetadataNativeEdited.pdn: the native re-save after selecting the top layer,
renaming it to "Edited top layer" in its properties dialog and saving to a new
file on 2026-10-25. All remaining properties and pixels are unchanged. Project
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0.

ResolutionInput.pdn: original 300x150 uniform-color fixture generated by
examples/resolution_probe.rs at 300 DPI (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
ResolutionNativeResaved.pdn: same fixture opened and re-saved in the native Windows
editor 5.1.12 on CASTOR on 2026-10-25. Its resize dialog reported 300 DPI and a
1 x 0.5 inch print size before re-save. No external artwork is included.

LegacyInlineInput.pdn and LegacyChunksGzipInput.pdn: original six-pixel fixtures
from src/pdn/write.rs legacy_tests, covering PDN3 plus gzip/inline pointerData and
headerless gzip/chunk arrays respectively. LegacyInlineNativeResaved.pdn and
LegacyChunksNativeResaved.pdn: corresponding native Windows 5.1.12 GUI re-saves
on CASTOR, 2026-10-25. Every layer pixel and property is unchanged. Project
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0. No third-party artwork is included.

RecolorRampInput.pdn: original 350x50 color/alpha grid from examples/recolor_probe.rs.
RecolorRampNative.pdn: native Windows 5.1.12 recolor operation on CASTOR,
2026-10-25: Sampling Once, opaque black replacement, 1000 px diameter,
100% hardness/tolerance, single click at document pixel (175,24). All 17500
output pixels match the Rust full-coverage operation exactly. Both fixtures
use MIT OR Apache-2.0 and contain no external artwork.
